query_text: Create a bubble chart for countries in the 2020 report that have at least one visible ranked city and at least 8 total sampled innovations, where the x-axis is `number of visible ranked cities / population in tens of millions`, the y-axis is `total sampled innovations / number of visible ranked cities`, bubble size is `total sampled innovations`, both axes use derived country-level ratios, countries with `city_rankings = unavailable` are excluded, and only the top 10 countries by `total sampled innovations / number of visible ranked cities` should be plotted.
value_unit: x in visible ranked cities per 10M people; y in sampled innovations per city; bubble size in sampled innovations
selection_rule: top 10 after visible city count >= 1 and total_innovations >= 8

plot_spec.title: 2020 City Coverage vs Innovations per City
